$comment: §4.2 numbering system (E2). Fields carry semantics; display_label is a human synthesis and is not a unique key. Deleted scenes stay OMITTED; numbers are never recycled. setupLetter skips I/O/S. Source: OMC slating + E2.
title: VPO Identifiers

scene_code.$comment: Raw scene number in the script namespace, e.g. A12. Do not parse meaning out of a compressed string.

sceneStableId.$comment: Locked-script id. Never changes, including after OMITTED. Must not encode US setup/insert letters I/O/S as a compressed slate, including successor marks (A12I-T3).

sceneInsertPrefix.$comment: Empty|A|AA|B. US default. ProductionOrder header declares naming_style. I/O/S are unrepresentable.

setupLetter.$comment: Empty|A|B|AA. Skip I/O/S. Rearranging I/O/S into this field is still illegal.

editorialShotId.$comment: Stable editorial-side id. Many-to-many with production numbers.

display_label.$comment: Human-readable synthesis such as A12B-T3. Not a unique structural key.

occurrence_id.$comment: ClipInstance occurrence. Same Shot may appear many times.
